summary_claims.claim: Keeps five cross-sectoral principles on a non-statutory basis; central function in DSIT for risk monitoring and coordination; targeted consultation on a cross-economy AI risk register.
Case for further targeted binding requirements on developers of highly capable general-purpose AI; relies on voluntary measures for now.

note: GOV.UK consultation outcome page and PDFs confirm CP 1019, presentation on 6 Feb 2024, 409 responses and the consultation dates. The new secondary_url (the consultation page) is a stored official page. Notes from version 1 about Labour policy and a deferred bill were removed for lack of a stored source; one targeted search found no bill on an official site, and the extractor's open question stands.
